Auto-discovery idea: Under-tested HDAC2 marks cell-type-specific peripheral trace stretching¶

Rationale¶

Follows direction coverage_gap-a888d9f27d by prioritizing HDAC2, an under-tested IF marker present in the schema, and asks whether HDAC2-marked chromatin has different geometry in Granule, Bergmann, and Purkinje cells.

Data used¶

Use chromatin tracing coordinates, trace and chromosome labels, cell-type metadata, tracks.HDAC2, and tracks.n_per_dist(um) to focus on peripheral versus non-peripheral chromatin neighborhoods.

Analysis sketch¶

Within each cell type, identify HDAC2-high spots and compare local consecutive-bin 3D distances for peripheral HDAC2-high spots against matched non-high spots from the same chromosome and trace. The single measurable parameter is the cell-type interaction effect on this peripheral stretch contrast.

Expected result¶

If HDAC2-associated chromatin reflects cell-type-specific repressive or remodeling compartments, peripheral HDAC2-high regions should show trace stretching or compaction in one cell type more strongly than the others.

Validation checks¶

Confirm all fields, sufficient cells and trace segments, finite outputs, a permutation interaction-test p-value, deterministic rerun, runtime under budget, and a control that permutes HDAC2 labels within cell and chromosome.

Exploration¶

The code agent can freely add cells below this point.

Critique and compact plan¶

The proposed full matched label-permutation model is biologically aligned but too large for this scaffold if it loops over every possible spot pair. I will approximate the intended parameter using only consecutive genomic-bin segments within each trace/chromosome: compute segment length in microns, assign each segment the mean HDAC2 signal and mean peripheral distance from its two endpoint spots, then restrict to peripheral segments. HDAC2-high segments will be defined by a global upper-quartile threshold within finite peripheral segments, and the per-cell contrast will be the median segment length for HDAC2-high minus non-high peripheral segments. The explicit hypothesis test will be a bounded within-cell/chromosome permutation of HDAC2-high labels to ask whether cell-type contrasts vary more than expected under label exchangeability while preserving trace geometry and peripheral segment composition.

# Main compact exploration for the HDAC2 peripheral trace-stretch interaction idea.
import os
os.environ.setdefault('MPLBACKEND', 'Agg')
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg', force=True)
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path
from IPython.display import display

rng = np.random.default_rng(20250214)
N_PERMUTATIONS = 500
RESULT_PATH = Path('/Users/weizexu/Projects/U-Chrom/tmp/takei_auto_discovery_doc/iterative_2x10_litsearch_rounds/iteration_02/under-tested-hdac2-marks-cell-type-specific-peri-fd7cab5a0d_result.csv')
FIG_PATH = Path('/Users/weizexu/Projects/U-Chrom/tmp/takei_auto_discovery_doc/iterative_2x10_litsearch_rounds/iteration_02/under-tested-hdac2-marks-cell-type-specific-peri-fd7cab5a0d_statistical_summary.png')
RESULT_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


# Assemble aligned spot-level table.
base = cdata.spots[['cell_id', 'trace_id', 'chrom', 'start']].copy()
base[['x_um', 'y_um', 'z_um']] = np.asarray(cdata.coords, dtype=float)
base['HDAC2'] = pd.to_numeric(cdata.tracks['HDAC2'], errors='coerce').to_numpy()
base['n_per_dist_um'] = pd.to_numeric(cdata.tracks['n_per_dist(um)'], errors='coerce').to_numpy()
cell_type_map = cdata.cells['cell_type'].astype(str).to_dict()
base['cell_type'] = base['cell_id'].map(cell_type_map)
base = base[np.isfinite(base[['x_um','y_um','z_um','HDAC2','n_per_dist_um']]).all(axis=1)].copy()

# Consecutive genomic-bin segments within each trace/chromosome; segment annotations are endpoint means.
segment_parts = []
for (trace_id, chrom), g in base.sort_values(['trace_id', 'chrom', 'start']).groupby(['trace_id', 'chrom'], sort=False, observed=False):
    if len(g) < 2:
        continue
    a = g.iloc[:-1].reset_index(drop=True)
    b = g.iloc[1:].reset_index(drop=True)
    dist = np.sqrt((b['x_um'].to_numpy() - a['x_um'].to_numpy())**2 +
                   (b['y_um'].to_numpy() - a['y_um'].to_numpy())**2 +
                   (b['z_um'].to_numpy() - a['z_um'].to_numpy())**2)
    segment_parts.append(pd.DataFrame({
        'cell_id': a['cell_id'].to_numpy(),
        'cell_type': a['cell_type'].to_numpy(),
        'trace_id': trace_id,
        'chrom': chrom,
        'start_left': a['start'].to_numpy(),
        'start_right': b['start'].to_numpy(),
        'segment_length_um': dist,
        'HDAC2_segment_mean': (a['HDAC2'].to_numpy() + b['HDAC2'].to_numpy()) / 2.0,
        'n_per_dist_segment_mean_um': (a['n_per_dist_um'].to_numpy() + b['n_per_dist_um'].to_numpy()) / 2.0,
    }))
segments = pd.concat(segment_parts, ignore_index=True) if segment_parts else pd.DataFrame()
segments = segments[np.isfinite(segments['segment_length_um'])].copy()

# Operational strata: peripheral = lower quartile distance to nuclear periphery; HDAC2-high = upper quartile HDAC2 among peripheral segments.
peripheral_threshold_um = float(segments['n_per_dist_segment_mean_um'].quantile(0.25)) if len(segments) else np.nan
segments['is_peripheral'] = segments['n_per_dist_segment_mean_um'] <= peripheral_threshold_um
peripheral_segments = segments[segments['is_peripheral']].copy().reset_index(drop=True)
hdac2_high_threshold = float(peripheral_segments['HDAC2_segment_mean'].quantile(0.75)) if len(peripheral_segments) else np.nan
peripheral_segments['HDAC2_high'] = peripheral_segments['HDAC2_segment_mean'] >= hdac2_high_threshold

cell_types = ['Granule', 'Bergmann', 'Purkinje']

def per_cell_contrasts(seg_df, label_col='HDAC2_high'):
    rows = []
    for cell_id, g in seg_df.groupby('cell_id', sort=True, observed=False):
        ct = str(g['cell_type'].iloc[0])
        labels = g[label_col].astype(bool)
        high = g.loc[labels, 'segment_length_um'].dropna()
        low = g.loc[~labels, 'segment_length_um'].dropna()
        contrast = float(np.median(high) - np.median(low)) if len(high) and len(low) else np.nan
        rows.append({
            'cell_id': cell_id,
            'cell_type': ct,
            'n_peripheral_segments': int(len(g)),
            'n_HDAC2_high_segments': int(len(high)),
            'n_HDAC2_nonhigh_segments': int(len(low)),
            'median_high_segment_length_um': float(np.median(high)) if len(high) else np.nan,
            'median_nonhigh_segment_length_um': float(np.median(low)) if len(low) else np.nan,
            'HDAC2_peripheral_stretch_contrast_um': contrast,
        })
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

def interaction_statistic(cell_df):
    finite = cell_df[np.isfinite(cell_df['HDAC2_peripheral_stretch_contrast_um'])].copy()
    med = finite.groupby('cell_type', observed=False)['HDAC2_peripheral_stretch_contrast_um'].median().reindex(cell_types)
    if med.dropna().shape[0] < 2:
        return np.nan, med
    return float(med.max() - med.min()), med

cell_result = per_cell_contrasts(peripheral_segments)
observed_statistic, type_medians = interaction_statistic(cell_result)

# Bounded negative-control/permutation test: shuffle HDAC2-high labels within cell/chrom among peripheral segments.
null_stats = []
if np.isfinite(observed_statistic) and cell_result['cell_type'].nunique() >= 2:
    grouped_indices = [np.asarray(idx, dtype=int) for _, idx in peripheral_segments.groupby(['cell_id', 'chrom'], sort=False, observed=False).indices.items()]
    labels0 = peripheral_segments['HDAC2_high'].to_numpy(dtype=bool)
    for _ in range(N_PERMUTATIONS):
        labels = labels0.copy()
        for idx in grouped_indices:
            if len(idx) > 1:
                labels[idx] = rng.permutation(labels[idx])
        perm_df = peripheral_segments.copy()
        perm_df['HDAC2_high_perm'] = labels
        perm_cell = per_cell_contrasts(perm_df, label_col='HDAC2_high_perm')
        stat, _ = interaction_statistic(perm_cell)
        if np.isfinite(stat):
            null_stats.append(float(stat))
null_stats = np.asarray(null_stats, dtype=float)

if len(null_stats) >= 100 and np.isfinite(observed_statistic):
    p_value = float((np.sum(null_stats >= observed_statistic) + 1) / (len(null_stats) + 1))
    hypothesis_test_status = 'pass'
else:
    p_value = 1.0
    hypothesis_test_status = 'insufficient_data'

effect_size = float(observed_statistic) if np.isfinite(observed_statistic) else 0.0
parameter_value = effect_size

test_method = f'within-cell/chromosome HDAC2-label permutation test ({len(null_stats)} permutations)'
null_hypothesis = 'Among peripheral consecutive chromatin-trace segments, the HDAC2-high versus non-high median segment-length contrast is exchangeable with respect to HDAC2 labels within each cell and chromosome, so cell types have no interaction in this contrast.'
alternative_hypothesis = 'At least one cell type has a different peripheral HDAC2-high versus non-high trace-stretch contrast, yielding a larger cross-cell-type median contrast range than expected under label shuffling.'

# Result table: one row per cell plus shared hypothesis-test evidence.
result_table = cell_result.copy()
for ct in cell_types:
    val = type_medians.get(ct)
    result_table[f'cell_type_median_contrast_{ct}_um'] = float(val) if np.isfinite(val) else np.nan
result_table['observed_statistic'] = observed_statistic
result_table['effect_size'] = effect_size
result_table['p_value'] = p_value
result_table['test_method'] = test_method
result_table['peripheral_threshold_um'] = peripheral_threshold_um
result_table['HDAC2_high_threshold'] = hdac2_high_threshold
result_table.to_csv(RESULT_PATH, index=False)

analysis_summary = {
    'idea_id': IDEA.idea_id,
    'parameter_name': 'HDAC2_peripheral_trace_stretch_interaction',
    'parameter_value': parameter_value,
    'null_hypothesis': null_hypothesis,
    'alternative_hypothesis': alternative_hypothesis,
    'test_method': test_method,
    'observed_statistic': float(observed_statistic) if np.isfinite(observed_statistic) else 0.0,
    'effect_size': effect_size,
    'p_value': p_value,
    'hypothesis_test_status': hypothesis_test_status,
    'n_permutations_requested': N_PERMUTATIONS,
    'n_permutations_used': int(len(null_stats)),
    'n_rows': int(len(result_table)),
    'n_selected_cells': int(result_table['cell_id'].nunique()),
    'n_segments_total': int(len(segments)),
    'n_peripheral_segments': int(len(peripheral_segments)),
    'n_HDAC2_high_peripheral_segments': int(peripheral_segments['HDAC2_high'].sum()) if len(peripheral_segments) else 0,
    'peripheral_threshold_um': peripheral_threshold_um,
    'HDAC2_high_threshold': hdac2_high_threshold,
    'result_path': str(RESULT_PATH),
    'figure_path': str(FIG_PATH),
    'notes': [
        'Peripheral segments are operationalized as the lowest quartile of endpoint-mean n_per_dist(um).',
        'HDAC2-high is the upper quartile of endpoint-mean HDAC2 within peripheral segments.',
        'Permutation shuffles HDAC2-high labels within cell/chromosome among peripheral segments; it preserves geometry, cell type, and group sizes within each stratum.'
    ],
}

# Statistical figure: observed group comparison plus null distribution.
plt.rcParams.update({'figure.facecolor': 'white', 'axes.facecolor': 'white', 'font.size': 10})
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11.5, 4.2), constrained_layout=True)
ax = axes[0]
positions = np.arange(len(cell_types))
for i, ct in enumerate(cell_types):
    vals = result_table.loc[result_table['cell_type'] == ct, 'HDAC2_peripheral_stretch_contrast_um'].dropna().to_numpy()
    jitter = rng.normal(0, 0.035, size=len(vals)) if len(vals) else []
    ax.scatter(np.full(len(vals), i) + jitter, vals, s=55, alpha=0.9, label=f'{ct} cell contrasts')
    med_val = type_medians.get(ct)
    if np.isfinite(med_val):
        ax.hlines(float(med_val), i - 0.23, i + 0.23, colors='black', linewidth=2, label='cell-type median' if i == 0 else None)
ax.axhline(0, color='0.5', linewidth=1, linestyle='--')
ax.set_xticks(positions)
ax.set_xticklabels(cell_types, rotation=20, ha='right')
ax.set_ylabel('Per-cell median stretch contrast\nHDAC2-high - non-high (µm)')
ax.set_xlabel('Cell type')
ax.set_title('Peripheral consecutive-bin trace stretch by HDAC2 status')
ax.legend(loc='best', frameon=False, fontsize=8)

ax = axes[1]
if len(null_stats):
    ax.hist(null_stats, bins=30, color='#bdbdbd', edgecolor='white', label='permuted null')
else:
    ax.text(0.5, 0.5, 'No finite null statistics', ha='center', va='center', transform=ax.transAxes)
ax.axvline(observed_statistic, color='#d62728', linewidth=2.5, label='observed statistic')
ax.set_xlabel('Interaction statistic: range of cell-type median contrasts (µm)')
ax.set_ylabel('Permutation count')
ax.set_title('HDAC2-label permutation evidence')
ax.legend(frameon=False, loc='best')
annotation = (f'p={p_value:.3g}\neffect={effect_size:.3f} µm\n'
              f'n cells={analysis_summary["n_selected_cells"]}, n seg={analysis_summary["n_peripheral_segments"]}\n'
              f'{len(null_stats)} permutations')
ax.text(0.98, 0.96, annotation, ha='right', va='top', transform=ax.transAxes,

Final interpretation¶

Hypothesis. HDAC2-enriched chromatin has a cell-type-specific peripheral tracing geometry, with peripheral HDAC2-high loci showing altered local trace stretch in Granule, Bergmann, or Purkinje cells.

Exploration. The notebook operationalized the idea as HDAC2_peripheral_trace_stretch_interaction: permutation-test interaction effect size for cells.cell_type on the difference in median consecutive-bin 3D distance between peripheral HDAC2-high spots and matched HDAC2-low/non-high spots. using modalities chromatin_tracing, if_tracks, cell_metadata in cell type(s) Granule, Bergmann, Purkinje. Required data fields checked: coords, spots.cell_id, spots.trace_id, spots.chrom, spots.start, cells.cell_type, tracks.HDAC2, tracks.n_per_dist(um).

Statistical evidence. U-Chrom runner status: Notebook verified. Test: within-cell/chromosome HDAC2-label permutation test (500 permutations). Observed statistic: 0.02445; effect size: 0.02445; parameter value: 0.02445; p-value: 0.6347.

Conclusion. Not supported (Expected direction). The statistical test does not support the idea in this linked Takei subset under the notebook's operational definition.

What verification means. Notebook verified means the run passed schema/data checks, produced finite numeric output, and included an explicit p-value/effect-size hypothesis test. It does not mean the biological hypothesis is automatically correct.

Checks passed. deterministic_rerun, finite_numeric_output, minimum_cell_count, minimum_spot_or_trace_count, negative_control_or_permutation, required_fields_exist, runtime_under_budget, statistical_hypothesis_test.

Main caveat. Peripheral segments are operationalized as the lowest quartile of endpoint-mean n_per_dist(um).
